# Nicholas De Souza

> Nicholas De Souza is a Toronto-based solution engineer, software engineer and founder who builds AI agents and takes them to production. Lead Enterprise Solution Engineer at Salesforce; founder of Digistax and Vowbird.ai.

## Pages

- [Home](https://nicholasdesouza.com/): Career highlights, current projects (Vowbird.ai, Digistax), past work and a ten-year career summary.
- [Digistax case study](https://nicholasdesouza.com/case-study.html): Every task is a graph of agents, with a person at every gate. A prototype agency where orchestrators delegate to role agents whose limits are set by permissions.
  Sections: The whole pipeline; The nine role agents; One request, start to finish; The same desk, on a phone; Anatomy of a job; Two validators who never meet; The graph decides who pays; Design principles
- [Product screenshot gallery](https://nicholasdesouza.com/gallery.html): Screens from Vowbird.ai, Digistax, Review Loop and the TMLP Statistics Platform.
  Sections: Vowbird.ai; Digistax; Review Loop; TMLP Statistics Platform

## Projects

- [Vowbird.ai](https://vowbird.ai): A wedding planner that does the tedious parts for you: one shared guest list, RSVPs that chase themselves, and invitations where an assistant answers guest questions. Free in early access.
- Digistax: Founded in 2018 as a service automation firm; now a prototype software agency where every task runs as a graph of AI agents, with a person approving every price, merge, deploy and email. See the case study above.
